Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate). Machine face plus docs wiring; no contract accept/reject change.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card (maintainer-ruled, #22449 B′ ruling `6078203801`, condition 2)`
Thread-read: 6081410390
Serial constraints cleared: #22482 landed (`5b12503c31`), which this card was serial behind on `build-upgrade-guide.ts`. PR #22499 is in the merge queue and adds 3 lines to `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` (its regeneration commit); this card's PR merges `main` after it and keeps the stub. #22507 (`domain:spec` seat 2) edits `translation.zod.ts` / `i18n-resolver.ts`, so ordinary concurrency applies. #22485 (the deletion) waits for this card.
